versions.changelog: v1.6.2: 88-scenario comprehensive test (10 categories: Daily Life, Work, Study, Programming, Shopping, Health, Travel, Entertainment, News, Edge Cases). Result: 85/88 passed (97%). Fixes: (1) Chinese question-word + brand rewrite ('怎么注册支付宝' → '支付宝 Alipay 注册支付宝') — Bing was returning dictionary entry for '怎么'. (2) Mixed CJK/Latin locale detection — 'iPhone 15 Pro 价格' now correctly detects zh-CN (was en-US → Korean results). (3) 特斯拉 rewrite strengthened. Per-category: Work/Programming/Health/Travel/Entertainment/Edge 100%, Daily Life/Shopping 100% after fix, Study 87%, News 75%.

v1.6.1: Strip leading 'best' from English queries to avoid Bing's Best Buy bug. Comprehensive 12-scenario test across 8 categories (EN-tech, EN-product, EN-compare, CN-product, CN-general, JA, Edge) — 11/12 passed before fix, 12/12 after. 'best noise cancelling headphones 2024' now returns Gizmodo/Pocket-lint/Wirecutter instead of Best Buy.

v1.6.0: Add Brave Search engine + reddit intent + Chinese brand disambiguation. Brave has its own independent index (not Bing-powered), giving better results for compound words, brand names, and Chinese queries. Auto chain is now Brave → DDG → Bing → Google. Brave 429s fail fast (no retry) to avoid delaying fallback. Query rewrites: 'reddit' queries left alone (word itself is signal, site: operator broke DDG/Bing); Chinese brand disambiguation (苹果16→iPhone, 特斯拉→Tesla汽车, 小米→Xiaomi, 华为→Huawei). Fixed 5 reported issues: 苹果16价格, 特斯拉降价, best mechanical keyboard reddit, best vscode extensions 2024, 2024年诺贝尔物理学奖.

v1.5.0: Fix quality scoring + query rewriting + news homepage filter. 5 issues reported by real users testing with local agents: (1) Bing 'Jetpack Compose' returned WordPress plugin — fixed by stricter phrase-matching quality scoring. (2) Quality 90/100 for irrelevant results — fixed: STRONG hit now requires query as contiguous phrase, not just any token. (3) News search returned CNN/BBC homepages — fixed: filterNewsHomepages() drops root-path URLs when recency_days set. (4) '小米SU7销量' no output — verified working (was a pre-v1.4 issue). (5) 'Rust vs Go' returned video game — fixed by query rewriting + 'both X and Y must appear' scoring rule. (6) 'TypeScript 5.6' returned generic pages — fixed: version numbers in query MUST appear in title/url for STRONG hit. Tests 13→18, all pass.

v1.4.0: SearXNG-style cross-engine merge + Bing hardening + quality gating. When no single engine clears the quality gate (30/100), results from DDG+Bing(+Google) are merged, deduped by normalized URL, and re-ranked using the SearXNG consensus formula (score = Σ engine_weight/rank). URL collisions keep the variant with the longer snippet (deedy5 rule). Bing hardened with _EDGE_CD/_EDGE_S cookies, DNT/Sec-GPC headers, and algoSlug_icon stripping (all from SearXNG). SearchSuccess outcome now includes quality score + warnings array. CLI shows quality inline. 13 tests (added cross-engine merge regression test). Techniques credited in source comments to searxng/searxng and deedy5/ddgs.

v1.3.0: MAJOR relevance fix. Bing's ensearch=1 flag was returning garbage for non-English queries (e.g. '巴黎奥运会' returned Facebook pages) — now only set for English locales. Added query-language auto-detection (kana→ja-JP, hangul→ko-KR, CJK→zh-CN, Cyrillic→ru-RU, etc.) so locale is picked per-query. Removed Google from auto chain (almost always returns JS-wall from datacenter IPs). Hardened parsers (Bing .b_factrow was URL breadcrumb not snippet; DDG snippet had nested related-search links). Test suite grew from 8 to 12 — new tests verify result RELEVANCE, not just 'any results returned'. Docs now lead with one-line install: npx clawhub install @Sakurakilove/local-search

v1.2.1: Add Chinese README (README.zh-CN.md) with cross-language navigation; name z-ai-web-dev-sdk explicitly in the Acknowledgements sections of README.md, README.zh-CN.md, SKILL.md, and LICENSE.txt (one sentence each, no comparison prose). No functional changes.

v1.2.0: Strip all upstream-cloud-SDK references from docs and code comments. Comparison table now contrasts against generic cloud-search skills. Added an Acknowledgements note in README.md and LICENSE.txt crediting the original MIT-licensed skill that inspired the canonical SearchFunctionResultItem shape. No functional changes.

v1.1.1: Polish SKILL.md landing page (Highlights / Quick Start / When-to-Use / Engine Comparison); add README badges (ClawHub / Version / License / Node / TypeScript / GitHub); tighten frontmatter description for cleaner ClawHub listing.
v1.1.0: Add --locale option (BCP-47); fix Bing returning localized results from non-US IPs via cc/mkt/setlang/ensearch/form params; per-engine locale handling.
